title: Beef alla Pizzaiola
author: Lorenzo
description: Thin beef slices simmered in tomato, garlic and oregano, like a pizza topping.
steps: Warm the oil with the garlic, add the tomatoes, crushed, the oregano and salt. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Lay the beef in the sauce in one layer, add the capers, and cook for 3–5 minutes, turning once, until just done.
Serve with basil and bread for the sauce.
